The forecasts see growth in output slowing further over the coming year, which is expected to reduce capacity pressures and help return inflation to target. quotes.text: At its meeting today, the Board decided to increase the cash rate target by 25 basis points to 4.85 per cent.
Inflation is now expected to remain above 3 per cent for the coming year and there is an increasing risk that higher inflation expectations will become embedded.
Given the revised inflation outlook and the continuing upside risks, the Board judged that a further tightening in financial conditions is warranted to support the return of inflation to target.
The Board will continue to do what it considers necessary to bring inflation sustainably back to target.
